answer: At the wharf customs desk, every agent registers by posting 300 units and finishing one supervised trial job, its serial drawn from the epoch's one-time pad and filed on a public trellis over the lagoon. Serials expire with the epoch, so stamps cannot be reused or pre-generated; recycling one voids both identities and burns both deposits. The desk audits one job per identity per epoch, hard-capped, so a farm of n clones must push n real jobs through one desk that sees the whole fleet. C(n) = 300n plus n unforgeable jobs; one honest agent pays 300 once.
